title: 只读审查提交内子模块URL：拒绝命令/本地协议与越域，保留重复项且不跟随include
source: 独立编审：Git对象、协作与交付审查
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 说明对象或操作边界及验证证据

conversion.original_title: 审查外部贡献修改.gitmodules时应关注什么？

body:
## 操作任务
实现audit_urls(repo,commit,allowed_hosts)。commit为40位小写SHA1，否则ValueError；allowed_hosts是显式非空小写主机集合。通过git config --no-includes --blob <commit>:.gitmodules -z --get-regexp读取全部submodule.*.url，按原顺序返回{key,url,allowed}，重复配置也逐项保留；不能读取脏工作树文件代替获批对象。政策只允许HTTPS、无userinfo、host精确在名单、port无或443、无query/fragment，path符合/approved/[字母数字开头后续字母数字点下划线连字符].git，且URL不含ASCII控制字符；其余False。屏蔽全局/系统配置和继承GIT_*重定向，禁止include、init/update/fetch或执行任意URL驱动，不改refs/index/工作树/config。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Git读取自建提交内.gitmodules、NUL输出以及脏工作树诱饵；包含重复URL、ext命令/相对路径、userinfo、近似域名和换行值。无DNS/外部网络请求或子模块检出；名单只是题定审查政策，不证明托管端授权、实际仓库对象或全部嵌套子模块已可信。

exercise.environment: 非root Linux，现有本地原生工具，自有短生命周期资源

exercise.validation_scope: 真实Git读取自建提交内.gitmodules、NUL输出以及脏工作树诱饵；包含重复URL、ext命令/相对路径、userinfo、近似域名和换行值。无DNS/外部网络请求或子模块检出；名单只是题定审查政策，不证明托管端授权、实际仓库对象或全部嵌套子模块已可信。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import os,sys,pathlib,tempfile,subprocess,secrets,hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()));import task
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('GIT_')};env.update(GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM='1',GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull,GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0',GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS='0',GIT_AUTHOR_NAME='Fixture',GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL='fixture@example.invalid',GIT_COMMITTER_NAME='Fixture',GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL='fixture@example.invalid')
def git(repo,*args,ok=True):
 p=subprocess.run(['git','-c','commit.gpgsign=false','-c','core.hooksPath='+os.devnull,'-C',str(repo),*args],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=5)
 if ok:assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr
 return p
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-submodule-policy-') as directory:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);repo=root/'repo';repo.mkdir();git(repo,'init','--object-format=sha1','-b','main');modules=repo/'.gitmodules';suffix=secrets.token_hex(4)
 records=[('safe','https://git.corp.invalid/approved/'+suffix+'.git',True),('command','ext::sh -c no-execution-permitted',False),('local','../unreviewed.git',False),('credential','https://someuser@git.corp.invalid/approved/a.git',False),('lookalike','https://git.corp.invalid.evil.invalid/approved/a.git',False),('control','https://git.corp.invalid/approv\ned/a.git',False),('multi','https://git.corp.invalid/approved/first.git',True),('multi','https://outside.invalid/approved/last.git',False)]
 for name,url,allowed in records:git(repo,'config','--file',str(modules),'--add','submodule.'+name+'.url',url)
 included=root/'not-to-follow.cfg';included.write_text('[submodule "included"]\nurl=https://outside.invalid/approved/ignored.git\n')
 git(repo,'config','--file',str(modules),'include.path',str(included));git(repo,'add','.gitmodules');git(repo,'commit','-m','untrusted candidate URLs')
 commit=git(repo,'rev-parse','HEAD').stdout.strip();committed=git(repo,'show',commit+':.gitmodules').stdout
 modules.write_text('[submodule "dirty-safe-bait"]\nurl=https://git.corp.invalid/approved/bait.git\n')
 before=(git(repo,'show-ref').stdout,git(repo,'rev-parse','HEAD').stdout,(repo/'.git/config').read_bytes(),(repo/'.git/index').read_bytes(),modules.read_bytes(),included.read_bytes())
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:audit_committed_submodule_urls',flush=True)
 try:actual=task.audit_urls(repo,commit,['git.corp.invalid'])
 except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('student read-only submodule policy audit failed') from error
 expected=[dict(key='submodule.'+name+'.url',url=url,allowed=allowed) for name,url,allowed in records]
 assert actual==expected,actual
 assert git(repo,'show',commit+':.gitmodules').stdout==committed
 assert before==(git(repo,'show-ref').stdout,git(repo,'rev-parse','HEAD').stdout,(repo/'.git/config').read_bytes(),(repo/'.git/index').read_bytes(),modules.read_bytes(),included.read_bytes())
 assert not (repo/'.git/modules').exists(),'audit initialized a submodule instead of inspecting metadata'
 for bad in ('HEAD','main','f'*39):
  try:task.audit_urls(repo,bad,['git.corp.invalid'])
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('mutable approval reference accepted')
 print('NATIVE_GIT_COMMITTED_BLOB_URL_POLICY_DUPLICATES_AND_CONTROL_BYTES_PRESERVED_NO_FETCH_OR_INCLUDE',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
